name: vETH virtual-liquidity factory unbacked mint

classification.summary: The vETH virtual-liquidity factory 0x62f250cf7021e1cf76c765dec8ec623fe173a1b5 exposed a permissionless addVirtualLiquidity(address,address,uint256,uint256) (selector 0x6c0472da) that called VirtualToken.takeLoan to mint up to the 300 ether per-block limit of unbacked vETH straight into a caller-named Uniswap V2 vETH/token pair, pulled only the matching amount of the counter token at the pair's live spot ratio, burned the resulting LP to address(0), and never called repayLoan. Because vETH is redeemable one-for-one for ETH through the whitelisted router, the caller could first push the pair's spot ratio with a flash loan so that 300 vETH required almost no counter token, then sell the counter token back and withdraw more ETH from VirtualToken than had been deposited. No parameter value fixes this: the loan is never repaid at any limit, so the deployed factory code mints an unbacked redeemable claim on every call.

loss.notes: Exact victim depletion measured as the native-ETH balance of the VirtualToken backing contract 0x280a8955a11fcd81d72ba1f99d265a48ce39ac2e, which fell from 493.212272163562760008 ETH at block 21184777 to 352.727119496848597852 ETH at block 21184796 with no other account activity in that window: 140.485152666714162156 ETH across the three campaign transactions (132.513467878004258374 + 4.846141416396402693 + 3.125543372313501089). The Balancer flash-loan principal is attacker-supplied and repaid inside each transaction, so it is not loss. The residual token inventory the attacker kept (BIF, Cowbo and BOVIN, plus 0.680685122899160147 leftover vETH) is deliberately not marked: the meme tokens were made illiquid by the attacker's own selling and the whole residue liquidated for about 1.35 ETH in transactions 0xfd6d05e7329526b72fd9ac5e24082fb74c9bc03bd2650a4b783cbbc309fc7a07 and 0x6391004ac335f7fd8e1e0986038ea46b0221a6138e4180019916bff4cd8c4e13, so counting spot marks would overstate the loss. The campaign minted 900 unbacked vETH in total; the 759.5 vETH not withdrawn as ETH remains an unrealised undercollateralisation of the same contract and is excluded from this figure.

lastCodeChange.description: The factory runtime was created by top-level CREATE in this transaction and is byte-identical at block 21056284, at block 21184777 immediately before the exploit, and today; the EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero and no DELEGATECALL leaves the contract in the anchor trace, so the deployment is the only executable-code change.

limitations: The factory runtime is not source-verified on Etherscan or Sourcify; the behaviour of addVirtualLiquidity was established from the execution trace of the anchor transaction and the verified VirtualToken counterparty source, not from the factory's Solidity.

sources.note: Re-reviewed the legacy vETH row from chain data. Anchor: 0x900891b4540cac8443d6802a08a7a0562b5320444aa6d8eed19705ea6fb9710b is status 1 at 21184778:50, timestamp 1731573347, and is nonce 1 of attacker EOA 0x713d2b652e5f2a86233c57af5341db42a5559dd1, whose nonce 0 created the attack contract 0x351d38733de3f1e73468d24401c59f63677000c9 six blocks earlier; it is therefore the earliest successful defect-executing transaction of the campaign. Scanning VirtualToken LoanTaken (topic 0xd5c776eab9418d89c040ffee59f2310d225f5ff682191bcee59b0413a7fd4835) from its creation block 21055969 to 21184800 returns 34 events, of which the only 300-ether loans are this transaction and 0x1ae40f26 (21184784) and 0x90db330d (21184796); the 31 earlier events are 3-20 ether protocol launches, so no earlier campaign transaction exists. Target re-identified: the legacy row named the vETH token 0x280a8955a11fcd81d72ba1f99d265a48ce39ac2e, but the defective executed code is the virtual-liquidity factory 0x62f250cf7021e1cf76c765dec8ec623fe173a1b5, which the DeFiHackLabs PoC also labels VULN_FACTORY and calls with selector 0x6c0472da = addVirtualLiquidity(address,address,uint256,uint256). The callTracer trace of the anchor shows that frame calling pair.getReserves, VirtualToken.takeLoan(0x0634866dfd8f05019c2a6e1773dc64cb5a5d3e6c, 300000000000000000000), LamboToken.transferFrom(attacker, pair, 565.732738475349771150) and pair.mint(0x0), emitting LiquidityAdded, and never calling repayLoan; the factory frame contains no DELEGATECALL, so the relationship is direct. Its 3848-byte runtime hashes to 0x0d13c25f732705f5740cb5a2d9f31d24f5af24c4dfdbf049c3220111c239414f at block 21056284 (creation), at block 21184777 (pre-exploit) and at head, while EIP-1967 slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc reads zero; the empty-code hash at 21056283 confirms creation in 0xbc302176dd0ee791133d959afa2cf527efcdaed03a1f7ef9ace7f1326f14dadc at 21056284:35 by 0xa614e5ee0a430ff60c64075ff540d08edee3af05, who is not an attacker address. Code age is 1731573347 - 1730023895 = 1549452 s (17.93 d), replacing the legacy 1553256 s that had been taken from the separate VirtualToken deployment. Loss re-measured from balances rather than from the reported headline: the VirtualToken ETH balance is 493.212272163562760008 ETH at block 21184777 and 352.727119496848597852 ETH at block 21184796, a depletion of 140.485152666714162156 ETH, matching the sum of the three transactions' cashIn/cashOut deltas exactly; at the DefiLlama ETH price 3216.8173326669325 for timestamp 1731573343 that is 451915.07 USD. The 32560.203560896180352774 WETH Balancer flash loan is repaid in the same transaction and excluded, and the attacker's residual token inventory is excluded because its later liquidation in 0xfd6d05e7329526b72fd9ac5e24082fb74c9bc03bd2650a4b783cbbc309fc7a07 and 0x6391004ac335f7fd8e1e0986038ea46b0221a6138e4180019916bff4cd8c4e13 realised about 1.35 ETH in total.

notes: VirtualToken 0x280a8955a11fcd81d72ba1f99d265a48ce39ac2e is the drained backing contract and executes the unbacked mint through takeLoan, but its loan primitive is gated by onlyValidFactory and behaves as documented; the missing repayment and the permissionless entry point live in the factory, so the factory carries the single code-age observation.
